alternatives to instant tanning makeup
I've only known this brand as a tanned body makeup. I like the satiny effect, and I mix it with a serum that gives a very subtle shimmer. I don't like the frosted granules to be visible. I'm traveling and couldn't bring anything. Any suggestions for the satiny glow effect and for the tanned makeup? Of course, just like we all like, so it doesn't stain, so it doesn't feel greasy. Thanks.
